tools.title: List BusyCal Accounts
tools.description: List the user's BusyCal calendar accounts. Returns account names, types, and enabled state. Only enabled accounts are returned by default.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: Include disabled accounts when true.

tools.title: List BusyCal Calendars
tools.description: List the user's BusyCal calendars. Returns calendar names, IDs, and whether each supports events or tasks. Can filter by account and exclude subscription, holiday, or birthday calendars.

parameters.name: accountID
parameters.description: Optional account identifier filter.

parameters.name: includeDisabledAccounts
parameters.description: Include calendars from disabled accounts when true.

parameters.name: includeWebDAV
parameters.description: Include WebDAV subscription calendars when true.

parameters.name: includeContactCalendars
parameters.description: Include birthday and anniversary calendars when true.

parameters.name: includeHolidayCalendars
parameters.description: Include holiday calendars when true.

tools.title: List BusyCal Calendar Sets
tools.description: List the user's saved BusyCal calendar sets, which are named selections of calendars the user switches between to filter the view. Each record returns `id`, `title`, `calendarIDs`, and `sortOrder`, with the built-in All Calendars set first and the rest in the user's own order. The `calendarIDs` match the calendar ids returned by `list_calendars`, so they can be used to narrow a later query to one set's calendars. This tool is read-only, takes no parameters, and omits calendar sets the user has locked.

tools.title: Get BusyCal Selected Items
tools.description: Return the events, tasks, or other items currently selected in BusyCal's main window. Records use the same unified shape as `query_items` (event, task, journal, graphic, or sticky fields with field-specific timezone identifiers when BusyCal stores fixed-time zone data), so the returned `id` values can be passed straight into update, move, defer, complete, duplicate, or delete tools without re-querying by text or date. Returns an empty list when nothing is selected.
tools.resultDescription: Selected item records using the same shape as query items.

tools.title: Get BusyCal Item
tools.description: Fetch one BusyCal item by its canonical occurrence identifier. Use the `id` returned by `query_items`, `query_events`, `query_tasks`, or `selected_items` to re-read that item without searching for it again. Returns the same unified record shape as `query_items` (event, task, journal, graphic, or sticky fields, with field-specific timezone identifiers when BusyCal stores fixed-time zone data), and reports an error when no item matches the identifier.
tools.resultDescription: Item record using the same shape as query items.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Canonical occurrence identifier returned by BusyCal query tools, such as `query_items`, `query_events`, `query_tasks`, or `selected_items`.

tools.title: Query BusyCal Items
tools.description: Search across events, tasks, journals, graphics, and stickies in BusyCal. Filter by keyword, date range, calendar, item type, or search field. Returns matching items with absolute date fields plus field-specific timezone identifiers such as `occurrenceTimeZoneIdentifier`, `startTimeZoneIdentifier`, `endTimeZoneIdentifier`, and `dueTimeZoneIdentifier` when BusyCal stores fixed-time zone data. If `isFloating` is true and those timezone fields are absent, treat the returned wall-clock values as floating and do not reinterpret them through the operator locale.
tools.resultDescription: Unified item records with absolute dates plus matching field-specific timezone identifiers when BusyCal stores fixed-time zone data. Floating items omit those timezone fields and should be treated as floating wall-clock values.

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: Optional full-text query.

parameters.name: calendarID
parameters.description: Optional calendar identifier filter.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Optional query lower date bound. When omitted but endDate is supplied, BusyCal uses the current time as the effective lower bound.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional query upper date bound. Leave empty for an open-ended search from startDate onward.

parameters.name: itemTypes
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated item types: event, task, journal, graphic, sticky.

parameters.name: searchFields
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated search fields: title, notes, tags.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Query mode: uiConsistent or rawExhaustive.

parameters.name: fetchLimit
parameters.description: Optional maximum result count.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Optional number of matching rows to skip after filtering and ordering.

Returns absolute `startDate` and `endDate` values together with `startTimeZoneIdentifier` and `endTimeZoneIdentifier` when BusyCal stores fixed-time zone data. If `isFloating` is true and those timezone fields are absent, treat the returned wall-clock values as floating and do not reinterpret them through the operator locale.
tools.resultDescription: Event records with absolute dates plus matching timezone identifiers when BusyCal stores fixed-time zone data. Floating events omit those timezone fields and should be treated as floating wall-clock values.

tools.title: Query BusyCal Availability
tools.description: Show free and busy time slots for a date range in BusyCal. Returns per-day breakdowns with absolute `date`, `windowStartDate`, `windowEndDate`, `startDate`, and `endDate` values. Each day and span also includes BusyCal's active `timeZoneIdentifier`; interpret those startDate/endDate values in that timezoneIdentifier rather than reinterpreting them through the operator locale. Can filter by calendar and respect working hours.
tools.resultDescription: Per-day availability records, each including absolute dates and BusyCal's active timeZoneIdentifier for interpretation.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Optional availability lower bound. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional availability upper bound. Defaults to the same day as startDate when omitted.

parameters.name: calendarIDs
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated calendar identifiers. When omitted, BusyCal uses its default availability scope.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Availability payload kind: free, busy, or both.

parameters.name: minimumDurationMinutes
parameters.description: Optional minimum free-span duration in minutes.

parameters.name: respectWorkingHours
parameters.description: Use BusyCal's configured day start/day end and working days when true.

parameters.name: busyTypes
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated blocking states: busy, tentative, outOfOffice, workingElsewhere, unknown.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Query mode: uiConsistent or rawExhaustive.

tools.title: Find Next BusyCal Availability
tools.description: Find the next free time slot in BusyCal that is at least a given number of minutes long. Returns absolute `startDate` and `endDate` values plus BusyCal's active `timeZoneIdentifier`; interpret those startDate/endDate values in that timezoneIdentifier rather than reinterpreting them through the operator locale. Can filter by calendar and respect working hours.
tools.resultDescription: The first matching free interval plus BusyCal's active timeZoneIdentifier, or missing value when no interval exists.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Optional availability lower bound. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional availability upper bound. Defaults to the end of the seventh day from startDate when omitted.

parameters.name: calendarIDs
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated calendar identifiers. When omitted, BusyCal uses its default availability scope.

parameters.name: minimumDurationMinutes
parameters.description: Minimum qualifying free-span duration in minutes.

parameters.name: respectWorkingHours
parameters.description: Use BusyCal's configured day start/day end and working days when true.

parameters.name: busyTypes
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated blocking states: busy, tentative, outOfOffice, workingElsewhere, unknown.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Query mode: uiConsistent or rawExhaustive.

tools.title: Create BusyCal Item from Natural Language
tools.description: Create an event, task, or journal through BusyCal's natural-language quick-entry parser. Provide the quick-entry text and the intended item type. Optional notes and calendar selection are applied after parsing.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Natural-language quick-entry text such as "Lunch with John tomorrow at 2pm" or "Finish report tomorrow".

parameters.name: itemType
parameters.description: Requested item type: event, task, or journal.

parameters.name: calendarID
parameters.description: Optional target calendar identifier. When omitted, BusyCal uses its default calendar for the requested item type.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Optional notes content applied after parsing.

tools.title: Create BusyCal Event
tools.description: Create a new event in BusyCal. Requires a title and start date. Supports optional end date, location, travel time, all-day flag, reminders, calendar selection, notes, and explicit IANA time zone identifiers. To place a timed event in a specific time zone, send an unzoned wall-clock `startDate` (no offset) together with `startTimeZoneIdentifier`; do the same with `endDate` and `endTimeZoneIdentifier` when the end zone differs. Omit the timezone identifiers to use BusyCal's current app time zone. For all-day events, send date-only values such as `2026-04-14`; when the event should run through a final day, pass that day as `endDate` and BusyCal expands its exclusive internal end boundary automatically. Only include `alarms` when the user explicitly asked for reminders.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Event title.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Required event start date/time. Use a date-only value like `2026-04-14` for all-day events, or an unzoned wall-clock string like `2026-04-14T14:00:00` for timed input. Pair timed string inputs with `startTimeZoneIdentifier` when the event should use a specific named time zone.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional event end date/time. Use an unzoned wall-clock string for timed input and pair it with `endTimeZoneIdentifier` when needed. For all-day events, a date-only value is interpreted as the inclusive final day, so `startDate: 2026-04-14` and `endDate: 2026-04-19` creates an event running through April 19.

parameters.name: startTimeZoneIdentifier
parameters.description: IANA time zone identifier for the timed `startDate`, such as `America/Los_Angeles` or `US/Eastern`. When present, the `startDate` string must be an unzoned wall-clock value (no offset). Omit to use BusyCal's current app time zone.

parameters.name: endTimeZoneIdentifier
parameters.description: IANA time zone identifier for the timed `endDate`, such as `America/New_York` or `US/Mountain`. When present, the `endDate` string must be an unzoned wall-clock value (no offset). Omit to use BusyCal's current app time zone. Requires `endDate`.

parameters.name: calendarID
parameters.description: Optional target calendar identifier.

parameters.name: allDay
parameters.description: Whether the event is all-day. For all-day events, prefer date-only startDate/endDate values.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Optional event location. Pass either a plain string or an object with keys such as title, address, latitude, and longitude.

parameters.name: travelTime
parameters.description: Optional travel time in whole minutes before the event starts. Use 0 for no travel time. All-day events and Apple Calendar accounts do not support this field.

parameters.name: alarms
parameters.description: Optional list of signed relative reminder minutes. Include this field only when the user explicitly requested reminders. Use `[]` to create the event with no reminders. Omit `alarms` so BusyCal keeps its own defaults. For example, `[-60, -15]` creates reminders 60 and 15 minutes before the event.

parameters.name: recurrence
parameters.description: Optional repeat rule. Requires `frequency` (`daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, or `yearly`) and accepts `interval`, plus either `count` or `until` (never both) to set how long it repeats. Use `weekdays`, `monthDays`, `months`, `yearDays`, `weekNumbers`, `setPositions`, and `weekStart` to narrow which occurrences repeat, and `regenerate` on tasks to repeat from the due or completion date. Omit `recurrence` to create a one-off item. A task needs a due date before it can repeat.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Optional event notes.

tools.title: Create BusyCal Task
tools.description: Create a new task in BusyCal. Requires a title. Supports optional due date, durationMinutes, reminders, calendar selection, notes, task priority, BusyCal starred status, and an explicit IANA time zone identifier. Use a date-only `dueDate` such as `2026-04-14` to create an all-day task on that day; include a time only when the user wants a timed task. To place a timed task in a specific time zone, send an unzoned wall-clock `dueDate` (no offset) together with `dueTimeZoneIdentifier`. Omit the due date to create an undated task. Omit `priority` to use BusyCal's configured default; use `none` to create the task with no priority. Only include `alarms` when the user explicitly asked for reminders.
tools.resultDescription: Created task record, including durationMinutes. Zero means no custom duration.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Task title.

parameters.name: dueDate
parameters.description: Optional task due date/time. A date-only value like `2026-04-14` creates an all-day task due that day. For timed input, send an unzoned wall-clock string and pair it with `dueTimeZoneIdentifier` when the task should use a specific named time zone.

parameters.name: dueTimeZoneIdentifier
parameters.description: IANA time zone identifier for the timed `dueDate`, such as `America/Los_Angeles`. When present, the `dueDate` string must be an unzoned wall-clock value (no offset). Requires `dueDate`. Omit to use BusyCal's current app time zone.

parameters.name: durationMinutes
parameters.description: Optional task duration in whole minutes, such as 30 or 60. Omit or use 0 for no custom duration. Requires calendar support for task durations or BusyCal's extended task properties setting. Todoist tasks need a due date and time.

parameters.name: calendarID
parameters.description: Optional target calendar identifier.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Optional task priority. Use `none`, `low`, `medium`, or `high`. Omit this field to use BusyCal's configured default priority; use `none` to create the task with no priority.

parameters.name: isStarred
parameters.description: Optional BusyCal starred state. Set true to star the task or false to leave it unstarred. Omit this field to use the normal default state.

parameters.name: alarms
parameters.description: Optional list of signed relative reminder minutes. Include this field only when the user explicitly requested reminders. Use `[]` to create the task with no reminders. Omit `alarms` so BusyCal keeps its own defaults. Tasks with no due date cannot accept non-empty alarm lists.

parameters.name: recurrence
parameters.description: Optional repeat rule. Requires `frequency` (`daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, or `yearly`) and accepts `interval`, plus either `count` or `until` (never both) to set how long it repeats. Use `weekdays`, `monthDays`, `months`, `yearDays`, `weekNumbers`, `setPositions`, and `weekStart` to narrow which occurrences repeat, and `regenerate` on tasks to repeat from the due or completion date. Omit `recurrence` to create a one-off item. A task needs a due date before it can repeat.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Optional task notes.

tools.title: Create BusyCal Task Calendar
tools.description: Create a new task calendar (task list) in BusyCal. Pass the calendar name in `name`, which must be 1 to 32 characters. There is no account parameter: BusyCal creates the calendar on the remote account that owns its default task calendar, and rejects local accounts and accounts that cannot create calendars.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name for the new task calendar, 1 to 32 characters. Required; `title` is accepted as an alias.

tools.title: Duplicate BusyCal Item
tools.description: Duplicate a BusyCal event or task. Creates a new copy of the item using BusyCal's edit pipeline. Omit `calendarID` to duplicate onto the source calendar. For recurring items, scope defaults to `one` (only the selected occurrence), unlike other commands which default to `all`.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Canonical occurrence identifier of the item to duplicate, as returned by BusyCal query tools.

parameters.name: calendarID
parameters.description: Optional destination calendar identifier from `list_calendars`. Omit to duplicate onto the source calendar.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Recurrence scope: `one` duplicates only this occurrence, `future` duplicates this and all future occurrences, `all` duplicates the entire series. Defaults to `one`.

tools.title: Open BusyCal Item
tools.description: Reveal an existing BusyCal event or task in the BusyCal app using its canonical occurrence identifier. Use the `id` returned by BusyCal query tools when you want BusyCal to focus a specific result.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Canonical occurrence identifier returned by BusyCal query tools, such as `query_items`, `query_events`, or `query_tasks`.

tools.title: Move BusyCal Item
tools.description: Move a BusyCal event or task to a different calendar. The destination in `calendarID` must be writable and must support the item's type. For recurring items, `scope` defaults to `one` (only the selected occurrence), unlike most commands which default to `all`; tasks always move as a single item because recurring tasks never detach. The returned record can carry a new `id` when the move changes the occurrence identity.
tools.resultDescription: Moved item record. A moved occurrence can carry a new identifier.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Canonical occurrence identifier of the item, as returned by BusyCal query tools.

parameters.name: calendarID
parameters.description: Destination calendar identifier from `list_calendars`. Required, and the calendar must be writable and support the item's type.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Recurrence scope: `one` moves only this occurrence, `future` moves this and all future occurrences, `all` moves the entire series. Defaults to `one` when omitted. Tasks always move as a single item.

tools.title: Move BusyCal Event
tools.description: Reschedule a BusyCal event to a new start date and time. The original duration is preserved. To move an event into a specific time zone, send an unzoned wall-clock `startDate` (no offset) together with `startTimeZoneIdentifier`. Omit the timezone identifier to use BusyCal's current app time zone. Use scope to control whether the change applies to one occurrence, future occurrences, or the entire series.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Occurrence-level event identifier.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Recurrence scope: one, future, or all.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Required new event start date/time. For timed input, use an unzoned wall-clock string and pair it with `startTimeZoneIdentifier` when the destination should use a specific named time zone.

parameters.name: startTimeZoneIdentifier
parameters.description: IANA time zone identifier for the timed `startDate`, such as `America/Los_Angeles` or `US/Eastern`. When present, the `startDate` string must be an unzoned wall-clock value (no offset). Omit to use BusyCal's current app time zone.

tools.title: Reschedule BusyCal Event
tools.description: Change a BusyCal event's schedule through `startDate`, `endDate`, `allDay`, and the matching time zone identifiers. Send at least one of `startDate`, `endDate`, or `allDay`; omitted fields stay unchanged. `startDate` and `endDate` must use the same time style, and for an all-day event a date-only `endDate` is the inclusive final day. `scope` defaults to `all` (the entire series) when omitted, unlike `move_item`, which defaults to `one`.
tools.resultDescription: Updated event record. For a recurring event this is the detached occurrence, the new future series, or the master, according to scope.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Canonical occurrence identifier of the event, as returned by BusyCal query tools.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Recurrence scope: `one` changes only this occurrence, `future` changes this and all future occurrences, `all` changes the entire series. Defaults to `all` when omitted.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Optional new event start date/time. For timed input, use an unzoned wall-clock string and pair it with `startTimeZoneIdentifier` when the event should use a specific named time zone. Omit `startDate` to leave the current start unchanged.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional new event end date/time. For an all-day event, a date-only value such as `2026-04-14` is the inclusive final day. An end before the start is rejected. Omit `endDate` to leave the current end unchanged.

parameters.name: allDay
parameters.description: Optional all-day state. Set true to make the event all-day or false to make it timed; converting to timed without new times keeps the day and applies BusyCal's default duration and floating-time preference. Omit `allDay` to leave the current state unchanged.

parameters.name: startTimeZoneIdentifier
parameters.description: IANA time zone identifier for the timed `startDate`, such as `America/Los_Angeles`. When present, the `startDate` string must be an unzoned wall-clock value (no offset), and all-day events do not accept it. Requires `startDate`. Omit to use BusyCal's current app time zone.

parameters.name: endTimeZoneIdentifier
parameters.description: IANA time zone identifier for the timed `endDate`, such as `America/New_York`. When present, the `endDate` string must be an unzoned wall-clock value (no offset), and all-day events do not accept it. Requires `endDate`. Omit to use BusyCal's current app time zone.

tools.title: Defer BusyCal Task
tools.description: Change a BusyCal task's due date. Omit the due date to make the task undated. To set a timed due date in a specific time zone, send an unzoned wall-clock `dueDate` (no offset) together with `dueTimeZoneIdentifier`. Omit the timezone identifier to use BusyCal's current app time zone. Use scope to control whether the change applies to one occurrence, future occurrences, or the entire series.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Occurrence-level task identifier.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Recurrence scope: one, future, or all.

parameters.name: dueDate
parameters.description: Optional new task due date/time. For timed input, use an unzoned wall-clock string and pair it with `dueTimeZoneIdentifier` when the due date should use a specific named time zone.

parameters.name: dueTimeZoneIdentifier
parameters.description: IANA time zone identifier for the timed `dueDate`, such as `America/Los_Angeles`. When present, the `dueDate` string must be an unzoned wall-clock value (no offset). Requires `dueDate`. Omit to use BusyCal's current app time zone.

tools.title: Complete BusyCal Task
tools.description: Mark a BusyCal task as complete. Optionally provide a completion timestamp. Use scope to control whether the change applies to one occurrence, future occurrences, or the entire series.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Occurrence-level task identifier.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Recurrence scope: one, future, or all.

parameters.name: completedAt
parameters.description: Optional completion timestamp.

tools.title: Reopen BusyCal Task
tools.description: Mark a completed BusyCal task as not completed. Use scope to control whether the change applies to one occurrence, future occurrences, or the entire series.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Occurrence-level task identifier.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Recurrence scope: one, future, or all.

tools.title: Update BusyCal Event
tools.description: Update a BusyCal event's title, location, travel time, notes, shared tags, My Tags, item URLs, or reminders. Provide at least one field to change. Omit a field to leave it unchanged. Use scope to control whether the change applies to one occurrence, future occurrences, or the entire series.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Occurrence-level event identifier.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Recurrence scope: one, future, or all.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Optional replacement title.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Replacement location string. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear it.

parameters.name: travelTime
parameters.description: Replacement travel time in whole minutes before the event starts. Use 0 to clear it, or omit this field to leave it unchanged. All-day events and Apple Calendar accounts do not support this field.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Replacement item URL. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear it.

parameters.name: locationURL
parameters.description: Replacement location URL. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear it.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Replacement comma-separated shared tags (e.g. "work, planning"). Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear all shared tags.

parameters.name: myTags
parameters.description: Replacement comma-separated My Tags (e.g. "personal, priority"). Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear all My Tags.

parameters.name: alarms
parameters.description: Optional list of signed relative reminder minutes. Omit to leave reminders unchanged. Pass an empty array to clear all reminders.

parameters.name: recurrence
parameters.description: Replacement repeat rule, using the same fields as when creating an item. Omit `recurrence` to leave the current repeat unchanged, or pass `null` to stop the item repeating. Recurring events follow `scope`, while a task's repeat rule always applies to that task alone and requires `scope: one`.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Replacement notes text. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear it.

tools.title: Update BusyCal Task
tools.description: Update a BusyCal task's title, notes, shared tags, My Tags, item URLs, reminders, durationMinutes, priority, or BusyCal starred status. Provide at least one field to change. Omit a field to leave it unchanged. Use `priority: none` to clear priority or `durationMinutes: 0` to clear a custom duration. Changes to a repeating task apply to that task only, so send `scope: one` for duration, priority, and starred changes on one; scope otherwise defaults to `all`.
tools.resultDescription: Updated task record, including durationMinutes. Zero means no custom duration.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Occurrence-level task identifier.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Recurrence scope. Defaults to `all`. Changes to a repeating task apply to that task only, so duration, priority, and starred changes on one need `scope: one`.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Optional replacement title.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Replacement task priority. Use `none`, `low`, `medium`, or `high`. Omit to leave unchanged; use `none` to clear priority. On a repeating task this applies to that task only, so send `scope: one`.

parameters.name: isStarred
parameters.description: Replacement BusyCal starred state. Set true to star or false to unstar. Omit to leave unchanged. On a repeating task this applies to that task only, so send `scope: one`.

parameters.name: durationMinutes
parameters.description: Replacement task duration in whole minutes. Omit to leave unchanged; 0 clears the custom duration. Requires calendar support for task durations or BusyCal's extended task properties setting. Todoist tasks need a due date and time. On a repeating task, send `scope: one`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Replacement item URL. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear it.

parameters.name: locationURL
parameters.description: Replacement location URL. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear it.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Replacement comma-separated shared tags (e.g. "work, planning"). Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear all shared tags.

parameters.name: myTags
parameters.description: Replacement comma-separated My Tags (e.g. "personal, priority"). Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear all My Tags.

parameters.name: alarms
parameters.description: Optional list of signed relative reminder minutes. Omit to leave reminders unchanged. Pass an empty array to clear all reminders.

parameters.name: recurrence
parameters.description: Replacement repeat rule, using the same fields as when creating an item. Omit `recurrence` to leave the current repeat unchanged, or pass `null` to stop the item repeating. Recurring events follow `scope`, while a task's repeat rule always applies to that task alone and requires `scope: one`.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Replacement notes text. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass an empty string to clear it.

tools.title: Delete BusyCal Event
tools.description: Delete a BusyCal event. Use scope to delete one occurrence, future occurrences, or the entire recurring series.

parameters.name: itemID
parameters.description: Occurrence-level event identifier.

parameters.name: scope
